signInBody: Welcome back! Make room for a little learning today.
signUpBody: Create your account and start growing today.
passwordLength: Use at least 15 characters. Spaces are welcome.
passwordRequirements: Use at least 15 characters and match both passwords.
checkFields: Check the fields above to continue.
policyNotice: The Terms of Service and Privacy Policy are not published yet. They must be approved before a public launch.
accountOptional: An account is optional. You can keep exploring lessons.
accountUnavailable: Account setup is not configured yet. You can still explore the lessons.
providersUnavailable: Google and Apple sign-in are not available yet.
providerUnavailableNotice: {{provider}} sign-in is not connected yet. No account has been accessed.
verificationGuidance: Open the confirmation link in your email, confirm it, then sign in here. An accepted request does not guarantee delivery. Check your spam folder or request another email.
resetGuidance: Use the latest password recovery link to choose a new password. After changing it, return here and sign in.
continueConfirmation: Continue to verify your email. Your current signed-in account will be kept.
continueRecovery: Continue to open password recovery. Your current signed-in account will be kept.
